step1_analysis.circuit_type: CML/ECL Latch or Buffer (part of MS-DFF)
step1_analysis.description: A high-speed current-mode logic (CML) or emitter-coupled logic (ECL) sub-circuit, likely a latch or buffer used in the master-slave delayed flip-flop (MS-DFF) for data retiming at 54 Gb/s.

paper_reference.title: SiGe-HBT-Based 54-Gb/s 4:1 Multiplexer IC With Full-Rate Clock for Serial Communication Systems

power_consumption.description: Total power dissipated by the sub-circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: P = V * I. Assuming ~3mA tail current per stage at 1.8V supply.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down from the full IC to a single latch/buffer block, adapted for a 1.8V supply instead of 4.8V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Swing = I_tail * R_load. Typically designed for 400mV in CML to avoid deep saturation.
sky130_expected.reasoning: CML logic typically uses 300-500mV swing regardless of technology to maximize speed.

sky130_expected.calculation: Limited by fT of SKY130 devices (~30-40 GHz for NPN/NMOS).
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 is slower than the 122-GHz SiGe HBT process, so transition times will be proportionally longer.

rms_jitter.description: RMS jitter of the output data

sky130_expected.calculation: Jitter depends on device noise and slew rate.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Lower fT and higher noise in standard CMOS/BJT compared to specialized SiGe HBT will increase jitter.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power, voltage swing, and rise/fall times of the ECL/CML buffer. Resistor values are appended to the DUT netlist to allow simulation.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SiGe HBT MUX Subcircuit Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param V_EE = -1.8
.param W_xm1 = 1 L_xm1 = 0.15

Vee VEE 0 {V_EE}
Vclk CLK 0 PULSE(-0.6 -0.2 0 10p 10p 100p 200p)
Vn5 N5 0 PULSE(-0.6 -0.2 50p 10p 10p 200p 400p)
Vn3 N3 0 DC -0.4

* DUT (Resistor values added for simulation)
R1 N10 N6 1k
R2 N7 VEE 1k
R3 N6 VEE 1k
R4 N4 VEE 1k
R5 GND N8 1k
R6 GND GND 1k
R7 GND VEE 1k
Q1 N2 N5 N6 npn
Q2 GND N2 N0 npn
Q3 N8 GND N0 npn
Q4 GND GND N2 npn
Q5 GND N3 GND npn
Q6 N3 CLK N4 npn
Q7 GND N8 N2 npn
Q8 N8 N8 GND npn
Q9 GND N5 N10 npn
Q10 N0 GND N7 npn
Q11 N8 N0 GND pnp

* Generic high-speed BJT models for simulation
.model npn npn (is=1e-16 bf=100 tf=10p cje=10f cjc=10f)
.model pnp pnp (is=1e-16 bf=50 tf=20p cje=10f cjc=10f)

.control
op
tran 1p 1n

* Power measurement
let power = -i(Vee) * 1.8
meas tran avg_power avg power

* Voltage swing measurement
meas tran v_max max v(N0)
meas tran v_min min v(N0)
let swing = v_max - v_min
print swing

* Rise and fall time measurement (10% to 90% of a -0.6V to -0.2V swing)
meas tran t_rise trig v(N0) val=-0.56 rise=1 targ v(N0) val=-0.24 rise=1
meas tran t_fall trig v(N0) val=-0.24 fall=1 targ v(N0) val=-0.56 fall=1

quit
.endc
